name: PhyXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Eight filters in the style of classic synths (MS-20, SEM, Minimoog, Matrix-12, 2600, Wasp, prologue, Polivoks) in one effect. Route audio from any filter into any other; modulate each from ten sources by touch patch bay or matrix. 28 patches. By L'Cronx, GPL-3. No third-party code; not endorsed by the makers of the originals.
